factories.requirements: Real captured view and object-store pins, active sealed catalog and canonical committed public-state directory; read-only, owned decoded values

limitations.reason: Only Directory/StaticJson/ObjectHashFile/LiveValue/Symlink routes. Mandatory captured StoreRoot/ViewId plus current CatalogRoot/StateDirectory preserve real pins; no direct mutation, frozen value, raw mmap or zero-copy guarantee.
Captured sanitized public state and immutable artifact reads are owned decodes; artifact access confers no backend capability or live identity authentication.

No Outcome/latest-result/error files. Shared nested receipt attribution, ordered attempt/terminal proofs and exact domain returns validate before completed success. Unknown completion forbids replay; declared recovery supplies caller-private status/proofs only.
Parent-relative operation/capability/dependency aliases stay inside mount; dependency target may be absent. Typed resolver does not silently follow an external OS target.

Generator emits exact supported source schema constructs and explicit unsupported/dynamic reports. Prior fs-core generation and GNU compilation ran before the Grok mounted-MCP changes; see reports/fs-core-20261005/release-preparation.json and HANDOFF.md 2026-10-05 final2 build entries. This source revision still requires regenerated artifacts and compilation; no deployment of its specializations is claimed.

EROFS.source_condition: Node does not admit requested write

EACCES.source_condition: Exact UID, mount mode, credential, session or capability admission refused

EBUSY.source_condition: Concurrent workspace writer or async job/reply waiter capacity

EBADF.source_condition: Unknown FD or wrong read/write access

other.source_condition: Other I/O preserved; raw errno remains diagnostic only

limits.origin: Current source bounds across mounted/store/source/FUSE/typed JSON ownership; backend allocator/native buffers and global EventChain are not claimed fully bounded

bindings.memory_policy: Fresh owned source decode per API operation; locator/topology/schema pins are bounded contract ownership; per-FD snapshots and explicitly returned BlobRef/ShmHandle values are owned snapshots, not shared reusable caches. No direct SHM mutation or raw memory mapping.
